amount.raw: Grants up to £200 for Scheme (A), up to £500 for Scheme (B), up to £300 for Scheme (C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligibility varies by scheme: Scheme (A) is open to undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and to postdoctoral scientist members within six years of their PhD viva. Schemes (B) & (C) are open to PhD student and postdoctoral scientist members within six years of their PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk at the conference they wish to attend with Genetics Society support.
opportunities.summary: The purpose of these grants is to support the attendance of Genetics Society 'junior scientist' members at conferences on research in Genetics.

opportunities.title: Genes & Development Summer Studentship

amount.raw: £425/week allowance for up to 8 weeks, up to £750 to cover host laboratory expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to undergraduate students, except those in their first or final year. The project must be based at a UK university. Both the student and the research group leader must be members of the Genetics Society.
opportunities.summary: Grants available to support undergraduate students to gain experience in any area of genetics by doing a research project during the summer holiday prior to the final year of their degree.
